summary: Frontend-only testing of boat details relayout + Email Ship's Log flow at 390px. All requested features verified working. 1 send to delivered@resend.dev succeeded.
critical_code_review_comments: EmailLogPanel.send: toast success message does not match request (shows 'Ship's Log emailed to ...'); not a bug but worth noting.
No obvious data-testid=validation-bar found when vessel/skipper/callsign cleared; could not confirm validation bar behavior via testid. If this is a regression requirement, confirm its data-testid.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified at 390px: Header row1 brand + network-status; row2 date-input (left) + gps-position (right). BoatDetails is a 2x2 grid (Vessel|Callsign / Skipper|Email) with testids vessel-input, callsign-input, skipper-input, email-input. No horizontal overflow. Changing date-input to 2026-10-12 updates checklist-item-text-87 to 'Departed Monday, 12 October 2026 ...'. Email entered at top persists after reload (localStorage) and renders in log-email-recipient as 'Sends to <email>'. When empty: 'Sends to add your email at the top' and clicking log-email-send-btn triggers error toast 'Please enter a valid email address at the top'. Send to delivered@resend.dev succeeded; log-email-status shows 'Emailed to delivered@resend.dev' with timestamp and PDF link. Button label is 'Email Ship's Log'. Toggling network-status to OFFLINE disables log-email-send-btn and shows log-email-offline-hint. list-selector contains 'Ship's Log'. Add-item placeholder on Ship's Log is 'My own Ship's Log...'; on Safety is 'My own Safety task name...'. Validation bar (data-testid=validation-bar) was not located when fields cleared—may use different testid or require trigger (export). Not flagged as a bug.
